description: This file is a Java Spring controller class that manages HTTP endpoints related to 'Curso' (Course) entities in a web application. It handles operations like adding, editing, deleting, listing, and viewing course details, and it incorporates security annotations for role-based access control.

classes.name: CursoController
classes.description: Spring MVC Controller handling HTTP requests for course management, including CRUD operations and course details view.

methods.name: addCurso
methods.description: Handles GET request to display a form for adding a new course associated with a specified professor.

methods.name: saveCurso
methods.description: Handles POST request to save a new course associated with a specified professor.

methods.name: getCursoForUpdate
methods.description: Handles GET request to retrieve course data for editing.

methods.name: updateCurso
methods.description: Handles POST request to update an existing course.

methods.name: getCursosList
methods.description: Handles GET request to list all courses.

methods.name: deleteCurso
methods.description: Handles GET request to delete a course.

methods.name: getCursoDetail
methods.description: Handles GET request to view course details and user's registration status.
